tools.name: book_demo
tools.description: Returns the URL to book a live demo of Saturation. Use when the user wants to see the product, talk to sales, or get a walkthrough.

tools.name: get_api_docs
tools.description: Returns the URL for Saturation REST API documentation and TypeScript SDK. Use when the user asks about integrating with Saturation or building on the API.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Returns the URL for Saturation pricing plans and feature comparison. Use when the user asks about cost, plans, or how much Saturation costs.

tools.name: get_support
tools.description: Returns the URL for Saturation support articles and how-to guides. Use when the user needs help with a product feature or troubleshooting.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search public Saturation.io content — blog posts, budget templates, film crew guides, film festival listings, tax incentive data, and product pages.

tools.name: start_free_trial
tools.description: Returns the URL to start a free Saturation trial. Use when the user wants to sign up, try the product, or get started.
